data.note: One Unity-frame read of stored state; bodies can have different calculation epochs. No UpdateTime, projection, force, fuel scan or navigation command is invoked. Display fields are last observed game-generated strings and may be older than this snapshot. The bounded events include orbit hooks and completed nav readouts capped at 20 Hz wall time while polled; captureEpoch is not a ship integration timestamp.

coast.scope: Undocked, unpowered, atmosphere-free normal simulation only; native angular motion retained.

data.note: Gravity-query counters, not counts of integrated objects. NavData playback can bypass numerical integration. No prediction, trigger evaluation or game-state mutation is performed by this endpoint.

data.name: Stellar Magnificence
data.fuelNote: Raw stored fields. Full/Edit ship values may be stale; no canister scan or fallback capacity calculation performed.

motionRelativeToScanTarget.note: Computed from stored ship and scan-target coordinates and velocities without calling UpdateTime; it may be stale if either ShipSitu has not advanced to the current epoch.

propulsion.note: Raw stored/runtime fields only. Materialized thruster count may be incomplete for shallow ships. No canister scan, fuel calculation, trigger evaluation, or thrust command is performed.

lowFuelPolicy.note: Game thresholds only. LowFuel was not called because it may scan fuel canisters for full/edit ships.

position.note: Stored coordinates; inspection does not call UpdateTime or project positions.

relativeToSelectedCrew.note: Approximate from stored centers; may differ from MFD collision-surface distance and projected positions.

data.savedDockLinksNote: Saved representation; may be stale for Full/Edit ships.
